name: Outing (Mixed)
tagline: Perfect for youth camps and larger gatherings.
description: A mixed deck made for the road: parks, cafes, camps, and big groups. Games and questions that turn any place into a moment with God.

cards.title: Today Is a Gift
cards.prompt: Say one thing you're thankful for about today.
cards.body: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

cards.title: Gracious Words
cards.prompt: Give one example of a gracious word you could say to someone nearby.
cards.body: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

cards.title: The Heavens Declare
cards.prompt: Point out one thing in your surroundings that shows God's creativity.
cards.body: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

cards.prompt: What's one thing in this place that shows God's creativity?
Who here would you like to know better, and what's one question you'd ask them?
What's your best memory of being outdoors with friends or family?

cards.title: Grateful Group Photo
cards.prompt: Take a group photo and have each person say one thing they're thankful for. Ask permission if anyone outside the group is in the frame.

cards.title: Kindness Run
cards.prompt: Do one small act of kindness for someone nearby, like offering to take a photo for a visitor.

cards.title: Nature Scavenger Hunt
cards.prompt: Teams find things that remind them of a verse: a light, a path, a rock, a seed. Photograph and explain each one.
cards.instruction: Stay together and stay safe. Most creative explanations win.

cards.title: Verse Spotting
cards.prompt: Find five things around you that connect to a Bible story and explain each connection.
cards.instruction: The group votes for the best connection.

cards.prompt: Share a time you felt God's presence in nature or a quiet place.
Share a favorite memory of a trip or outing where you saw God at work.
